body:
Triage: lands in objectui's detail-page header (the built-in Edit button's visibility wiring) ⇒ seam card stays here with `repo:objectui`, for the objectui whole-repo seat. Queued as Bug: same-shape predicate honoured by `delete` (list row + overflow menu) and ignored by the built-in header `edit` — an A/B-verified UI-entry convergence defect on rc.6. Not p0: the server-side permission/RLS backstop holds (submit is rejected, no data-integrity exposure); the cost is UX + repeated QA findings.

Adjacent, not duplicate: #3076 (the per-record CEL capability this is a gap in), #7692/#7758 (the `create` face, resolved). Sibling of #8500 — same page surface, different mechanism (declared `visibleWhen` not consumed vs CEL evaluation fail-open); serial-check the file surface if both are in flight at once.

Size/model suggestion: S–M.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine。

**ACCEPT (premise-falsified + coverage delivered)** — PR objectstack-ai/objectui#4666 (reviewer of record: seat session `session_01RnQd8iMMUwFupVRt`… correction: `session_01RnQd8iMMUwXQEV1crFmQiQ`).

The defect is not live on objectui main: the wiring landed between rc.6 and 17.5.0 on both detail surfaces (PR #4524 for the console record page, PR #4515 for plugin-detail), and the dispatch's fallback hypothesis (unwired consumption seam) was also falsified — `editVisible` is consumed as a conjunct of the `sys_edit` gate. What the card actually exposed is a coverage hole at the intersection of two existing pins: session-user (`os.user`) × relation field × the **built-in** path had never been evaluated under test. Delivered as an 8-case pin where every case is a discriminating pair (executor loses Edit, any other user keeps it — the "present" half is what a fail-closed fault cannot fake), both payload shapes, plus a no-fault-warning assertion. Reverse verification restored the rc.6 state and reddened exactly the predicted five. `Fixes` line is correct: with behavior verified and the pin added, this card closes on merge.

@baozhoutao — same disposition as #8500/#8282: your rc.6 measurement was accurate for rc.6; on ≥17.5.0 `userActions.edit.visibleWhen` governs the header's built-in Edit exactly as delete. Please re-test on a refreshed image; reopen with the build hash if it still reproduces.

Landing: ready + auto-merge once gates conclude green on head `3fcc3311f`.
